user.description: Connect Home Assistant to your Crewmeister account.

data_description.base_url: Only change this if Crewmeister told you to use a different API endpoint.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Crewmeister
reauth_confirm.description: The password for {username} is no longer valid. Please enter the current password.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Crewmeister API.
error.no_identity: Your Crewmeister profile could not be determined.
error.insecure_url: The API URL must start with https:// so that the password is sent encrypted.

abort.already_configured: This Crewmeister account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: The credentials belong to a different Crewmeister account.

init.title: Configure Crewmeister
init.description: All features are optional. Each section is saved when submitted. For automatic stamping: set up office and/or home office first, then the stamping rules.

menu_option_descriptions.schedule: Working days, target time, holidays, vacation from a calendar or sensor
menu_option_descriptions.home_office: Detection via smart plug and presence sensor
menu_option_descriptions.rules: Arriving, break window, end of day, walking time
menu_option_descriptions.breaks: Break reminder, add missing break, end of day reminder
menu_option_descriptions.advanced: Location on stamps, polling interval, stamp defaults

schedule.title: Working time & absences
schedule.description: No automatic clock in on days off, holidays and during absences.

data_description.workdays: No automatic clock in on other days.
data_description.daily_hours: Basis for the end of day period, the end of day reminder and the live display. 0 = no target.
data_description.workday_entity: Optional, e.g. from the Workday integration to skip public holidays.

data_description.absence_calendar: An all day event today counts as vacation, e.g. from your private calendar.
data_description.absence_keywords: E.g. “Vacation”. Empty = every all day event.
data_description.absence_sensor: Binary sensor or input boolean that is on during vacation.
data_description.absence_states: Also applies to the calendar of the integration.

data_description.window_start: Arriving earlier clocks in at this time.
data_description.window_end: No automatic clock in after this time.

office.title: Office
office.description: How being at the office is detected. What is stamped then is set under “Stamping rules”.

data_description.person: Home Assistant person of this Crewmeister user. Needed for zones and home office.
data_description.work_zones: Being in one of these zones counts as “at the office”.
data_description.wifi_sensor: Wi-Fi connection sensor of the Companion App, e.g. sensor.phone_wifi_connection.
data_description.wifi_ssids: Being connected to one of these networks counts as “at the office”.
data_description.presence_entities: Binary sensors or input booleans that are on at the office.
data_description.office_combine: Applies if several sources are set up. An unavailable sensor never counts as “away”.

data_description.arrival_delay: How long you must be there before anything happens. The stamp still gets the time of arrival.
data_description.departure_delay: How long you must be away. Protects against Wi-Fi dropouts and GPS jumps.

home_office.title: Home office
home_office.description: Home office is detected while you are at home and one of the signals is active. The same stamping rules as at the office apply, without walking time.

detection.name: Detection

data_description.home_office_power_threshold: Above this power the PC counts as in use. Choose more than the standby consumption.
data_description.home_office_presence_sensors: E.g. a presence sensor at the desk or “session unlocked” from HASS.Agent.

detection.description: One signal is enough. The person must be at home.

data_description.home_office_activity_delay: How long a signal must be active without interruption.
data_description.home_office_idle_timeout: Without a signal for this long counts as leaving (break or end of day depending on the stamping rules).

rules.title: Stamping rules
rules.description: {notify_hint}Apply to office and home office. “Ask” sends a notification with buttons. Leaving outside the break window and the end of day period never clocks out.

data_description.clock_in_mode: If you already clocked out today, it only asks.
data_description.arrival_offset: Added to the time of arrival, e.g. from the parking lot to the desk (office only).

data.break_window_auto: Start the break automatically at the beginning
data.break_window_resume: Remind to resume work at the end

data_description.break_mode: Leaving in this window starts a break, coming back ends it.
data_description.break_window_auto: Starts the break even without leaving, e.g. lunch at the desk.

data.end_of_day_mode: Leaving in the end of day period
data.end_of_day_on_target: Once the target working time is reached

data_description.end_of_day_mode: Leaving from this time on clocks out.
data_description.end_of_day_on_target: Start of work + target time + required break. The earlier of both times applies.
data_description.departure_offset: Subtracted from the time of leaving (office only).
data_description.catch_up: If you left earlier and are still away when the end of day period starts, you are clocked out at the time you left.

data_description.ask_on_leave: Asks with the buttons “Break” and “Clock out”. Without an answer nothing happens.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Questions, reminders and the live display are sent via the Home Assistant Companion App (Android and iOS).

data.notify_live: Live display (iOS Live Activity / Android Live Update)

data_description.notify_targets: Devices with the Home Assistant Companion App (notify.mobile_app_…). Without a device no notifications are sent.
data_description.notify_confirmations: A short confirmation after every stamp made by the assistant.
data_description.notify_live: Work time with a running clock, progress and expected end on the lock screen. Requires Home Assistant 2026.7, iOS 17.2 or the current Android app. iOS additionally gets a silent notification with buttons.

breaks.title: Breaks & reminders
breaks.description: {notify_hint}Reminders have buttons to stamp and to “remind later”.

data.break_end_reminder: Notify when the break is over
data.auto_resume: Resume work automatically after the break

data_description.break_reminder_after: Continuous work without a break. 0 = off.
data_description.break_duration: For the notification at the end of the break and resuming automatically.

data_description.break_check: If the required break is missing, asks how long it was (15 / 30 / 45 min or none).
data_description.break_default: This break is added if you do not answer. 0 = add nothing.

data.forgotten_check_time: Check for forgotten clock out at

data_description.end_of_day_reminder: Asks after start of work + target time + required break + grace time whether to clock out.
data_description.max_work_hours: Warns when today's work time reaches this value. 0 = off.
data_description.reminder_time: Reminds at this time if you are still clocked in. Empty = off.
data_description.forgotten_check_time: If a shift of an earlier day is still running, offers to clock out at the time you left. Empty = off.

data.end_of_day_grace: Grace time of the end of day reminder

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: You usually do not need to change these values.

data_description.update_interval: How often the stamp status is polled from Crewmeister (300–3600 seconds).
data_description.stamp_note: Added to stamps made by buttons and to service calls without their own note.
data_description.stamp_time_account_id: Time account for stamps unless the service call specifies one.

location.name: Location on stamps

data_description.location_as_note: For accounts that may not set the location of a stamp (error when stamping): the location is appended to the note instead.

location.description: Every stamp made via Home Assistant includes the work location. Your employer can see it in Crewmeister.

error.wifi_incomplete: Wi-Fi requires the sensor and at least one Wi-Fi name.
error.break_window_incomplete: Please enter the start and end of the break window.
error.break_window_missing: Breaks when leaving require a break window.
error.end_of_day_never: Enter a time for the end of day or enable “Once the target working time is reached”.

options.all: All must apply (e.g. Wi-Fi reaches the parking lot)

no_shift_to_pause.message: There is no active shift to pause.

no_shift_to_clock_out.message: There is no active shift to clock out from.

stamp_failed.message: Failed to create the Crewmeister stamp: {error}

entry_not_found.message: Crewmeister configuration entry {entry_id} was not found.

entry_not_loaded.message: Crewmeister configuration entry {entry_id} is not loaded.

multiple_entries.message: Several Crewmeister accounts are configured. Select the account to stamp for.

insecure_url.message: The Crewmeister API URL does not use HTTPS. Please set up the integration again with an https:// address.

live_disabled.message: The live display is not enabled. Turn it on in the assistant options and select a notification device.

live_clocked_out.message: The live display is only shown while you are clocked in.

status_unavailable.message: The Crewmeister status is currently unavailable.

note.name: Note
note.description: Note attached to the stamp. Overrides the default note.

time_account_id.name: Time account ID
time_account_id.description: Time account assigned to the stamp. Overrides the default time account.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: Crewmeister account to stamp for. Required if several accounts are configured.

show_live.name: Show live display
show_live.description: Shows the live display on the notification devices again, e.g. after it was swiped away.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: Crewmeister account whose live display is shown. Required if several accounts are configured.
